title: Aynova Stream
description: A full-stack, production-grade live sports streaming platform — football, cricket, UFC, F1 and more in HD — with a real-time match feed, a DRM-capable video player, an installable PWA, and a complete admin dashboard.

features: Live & upcoming match dashboard — auto-categorized Live / Upcoming / Ended with live countdowns
Multi-sport: football, cricket, basketball, tennis, F1, UFC/MMA + a FIFA World Cup spotlight
Resilient video player (Shaka Player + hls.js) — HLS, DASH & DRM streams, multi-server/quality switching
Branded Live TV channel grid with dedicated watch pages
Installable PWA — home-screen install, full-screen launch, Android-TV / D-pad remote support
Full admin dashboard — pin/hide/banner/override matches, channels, ads, API config & cron scheduler
details.challenges: Building a resilient site on top of an unreliable third-party sports feed — a provider timeout used to blank out all matches and their streams.
details.solutions: A two-cache design keeps the raw provider payload and the normalized matches separate, preserving the last-good set; admin overrides (pin/hide/banner/custom links) are merged onto the live feed at request time; and the Express app is serverless-aware (pooled Mongo connection, cron guarded behind VERCEL).

title: AI Translator
description: A full AI language studio running on the edge — 240+ languages, tone modes, 12 AI tools, chat and text-to-speech, all in a single Cloudflare Worker.

features: 240+ languages with auto-detect, searchable pickers & country flags
6 tone modes + 7 domain contexts (Business, Legal, Medical…)
12 one-click AI tools — Improve, Summarize, Email/Social, Simplify, Fix Grammar, Reverse-check with similarity %
AI chat about any translation + a floating 'Lingo' assistant
Text-to-speech, history & drafts, PWA install, light/dark themes
Edge-native: one Worker serves the UI + versioned /api/v1, key kept fully server-side
details.challenges: Serving a static UI and a JSON API from a single Cloudflare Worker while keeping the OpenAI key fully server-side and secure.
details.solutions: Edge-native architecture with Hono + Zod validation, a bundler-free build assembling HTML/CSS partials, security headers (CSP/HSTS), rate limiting, and CI with lint + 23 Vitest tests.

title: AstroVision
description: A full-stack astronomy research tool to view and analyze astronomical FITS images — interactive viewer, statistics, histograms, image processing, and edge & star detection powered by Astropy & Photutils.

features: Interactive FITS viewer — zoom, pan, fullscreen, live pixel coordinate & intensity readout
Statistics & interactive zoomable histogram (mean, median, std-dev, dynamic range)
Searchable full FITS header / metadata panel (telescope, instrument, exposure, filter)
Image processing — brightness, contrast, gamma, normalize, invert, blur, sharpen
Edge detection (Sobel, Laplacian, Canny) & star detection via Photutils DAOFIND
Side-by-side comparison view with a draggable divider
Export PNG/JPEG renders, statistics & histogram CSV, metadata JSON
One-click bundled sample datasets (nebula, galaxies, lunar terrain, star fields)
details.challenges: Handling large scientific FITS images efficiently while keeping the browser fast and rendering them the way professional astronomy software does.
details.solutions: Two-tier architecture — a Python FastAPI backend (Astropy, NumPy, SciPy, OpenCV, Photutils) parses FITS and returns display-ready PNGs over a typed JSON API, using a ZScale interval + asinh stretch for realistic rendering, while the Next.js / TypeScript frontend stays lightweight.
